panels.description: Compact pipeline support matrix. This panel avoids Data does not have a time field by using an instant query. Supported sections should show observed metrics; not_implemented/unsupported sections intentionally omit observed series, while scrape lifecycle/staleness can temporarily make live series look empty.
panels.title: Pipeline support matrix

panels.description: Small observed pipeline panel. Supported sections emit zero-valued stage series, so no data means support is not implemented, get_pipeline_diagnostics publish path is not running, or scrape lifecycle/staleness.
panels.title: Pipeline stage messages

panels.description: Small observed pipeline panel. Supported sections emit zero-valued blocked reason series; dispatch capacity only emits the active blocked reason, so absence should be interpreted with Pipeline support matrix first.
panels.title: Pipeline blocked reasons

panels.description: Small observed pipeline panel. Pipeline worker capacity is emitted when the workers section is supported and worker diagnostics are available; engine_type is async or process.

panels.description: Small observed pipeline panel. Current settlement blocker state: supported healthy settlement emits all reasons as 0; unsupported settlement relies on pipeline support matrix.
panels.title: Pipeline settlement blockers
